title: Selection Frequency Evaluation Protocol
purpose: Measure how often the frozen Skill naturally produces independent actionable ideas without changing its decision thresholds to hit a target frequency.

currentQuarterEndEstimate.caveat: Quarter-end checkpoint backtests measure decision quality, not true live selection frequency. They can miss opportunities that appeared and were absorbed before quarter-end.

rollingReplayDesign.cutoffRule: At each checkpoint, only evidence publicly available by that timestamp may be used.
rollingReplayDesign.eventFreshnessRule: Use the frozen Skill's novelty/baseline rules; do not relabel continuation as new to increase signal count.

deduplication.reopenOnlyIf: A source-linked genuinely new driver, explicit invalidation-and-recovery, or separately validated re-underwrite creates a new decision state.

interpretationRules: Do not optimize for a preselected signal count.
A low frequency with high quality is valid; a high frequency with degraded base-horizon quality is not an improvement.
Multiple stocks expressing one economic thesis count as one opportunity cluster for frequency.
Research selections are tracked separately from actionable Primary selections.
Same-window frequency outcomes may diagnose but may not tune the Skill; threshold/rule changes require another untouched window.
